[NGST.1.1] libds is distributed as a per-platform native tarball. An
integrator needs three things from it: `include/libds.h`, the public header;
`lib/libds.a`, the runtime; and `lib/libprotobuf-c.a`, which loading a `.dsc`
requires. The headers under `include/internal/` are not part of the public
contract.
